text:
anya: Quick proposal 1: run a 3-week mini-course (3 short tutorials) + a 45m webinar to showcase the new refapp benchmarks and drive dev signups.
chris: Yes. Two audience tracks: dev hands-on + infra ROI.
elaine: I'll write the 3-email drip and 6 short social posts (X + LinkedIn). CTA variants: "Run the refapp" (dev) vs "See production economics" (infra).
sam: Routing: web form -> HubSpot -> tag by track -> Slack alert channel #marketing-webinar-inbound. I'll add a triage doc for SDRs.
rachel: For the landing page we should include a small live demo iframe and a CLI quickstart. Small iframe snippet: 
```html
<iframe src="https://demo.redwood.dev/refapp/mini" width=780 height=420></iframe>
```
marco: I'll add a tiny JS badge that shows latency and cost estimate on demo runs. Ops note: need CORS and rate limit, I'll open a ticket.
chris: Headline stat: "~4x cost reduction in chat flows with prefix KV caching". We'll present a headline + appendix CSV/config.
anya: liam can export the benchmark CSV and config; liam please post links.
elaine: timeline: draft copy + emails by tomorrow noon, social snippets by EOD.
sam: HubSpot webhook (example):
```bash
curl -X POST https://hooks.hubspot.com/forms/v2/submit/99999 \ 
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \ 
  -d '{"email":"{{email}}","company":"{{company}}","track":"mini-course"}'
```
anya: action list: 1) liam: bench CSV/config 2) elaine: emails + social 3) marco: iframe + badge mock 4) sam: HubSpot + Slack routing 5) chris: landing copy. I'll compile a mini brief and calendar invite.
chris: cool, once we have CSV link I'll draft appendix table.
marco: ticket opened for demo host CORS: OPS-3121.
anya: thanks all, I'll post the brief here when ready. :rocket:
